unit: One complete selected page per source PDF; not full-document end-to-end recall. 50 signed documents plus 50 negative page controls from 50 other source PDFs.
target: Visible handwritten signature or signing initial (including scanned facsimile). A stamp or a typed digital signature alone does not count. This does not authenticate a signature.
selection: Search-discovered public PDFs, shuffled seed20261005; manually eligible visible signing marks, excluding uncertain examples. Convenience sample, not a probability sample of the internet.
split_method: Publisher grouped holdout, exact 30 positive + 30 negative development pages; 20 positive + 20 negative held-out pages. Same publisher and related scanned/typed copies never cross splits.

review_corrections.action: Moved to negative: printed names and editorial comment, no handwritten signature.
Excluded from negatives: cursive signing appearance ambiguous.
Corrected page number during whole-page visual review; p4 is blank.
Replacement positive visually confirmed before inference.
